title: Integration
description: A gate verdict, ticket payload, or notification payload produced from a Policy Engine verdict (policy/engine.py's evaluate()/evaluate_report()) over a ScanReport. See plans/016-action-layer-integrations-gate.md and meetings/2026-07-23-1100-plan-016-kickoff.md in the security-skill-workspace repo. Pure data, vendor-agnostic (generic-webhook decision at kickoff): no field here implies a webhook was actually called, a ticket was actually created, or a message was actually sent — that delivery is a future plan's job once a real target system is chosen.

aggregateAction.description: Copied verbatim from policy/engine.py's evaluate()'s aggregateAction — this schema never re-derives or re-decides it.

shouldBlockMerge.description: True iff aggregateAction == 'block-merge'. A CI step gates on this (or on this module's own CLI exit code, which mirrors it 1:1) — not on aggregateAction's string value directly, so a future addition to ACTION_ORDER can't silently change what blocks a merge without this field's own definition changing too.

findingCount.description: Number of non-suppressed findings the verdict was computed over (len of evaluate()'s perFinding).

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary, e.g. 'block-merge: 2 Critical finding(s) require action before merge.'

findingId.description: The finding.schema.json Finding this ticket is for.

description.description: Markdown body, including the finding's standard references (CWE/OWASP/etc.) so a ticket lands with the same citations a human reviewer would want (per วิน's request at kickoff).

labels.description: Vendor-agnostic label strings (e.g. 'security', 'severity:medium', subSkill name) — a future per-vendor adapter maps these to whatever label/tag mechanism that system actually has.

findingId.description: The finding.schema.json Finding this notification is for.

text.description: Short plain-text message body, suitable as-is for a generic chat webhook's message field.
